article:
For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

[--- Table Start ---]
| Spanish conversation club We're a group of people aged 16-25 who meet every week for two hours of chat in Spanish. You don't have to be able to speak much Spanish: we welcome beginners, too. We talk about anything (27)…………… as interesting people, from food people enjoy (28)…………… literature and politics.  We meet between 4.30 p.m. (29)…………… 6 p.m. every Tuesday, in a large, comfortable room in the Central Library. The sessions are free, but we do ask people to pay £1 a session for coffee or juice. Staff from the School of Tourism at the University set (30)…………… the group three years ago, but it's now organised (31)…………… volunteers. The number of members (32)…………… grown a lot during this time. As well as allowing people to practise their Spanish, the club brings people from different backgrounds together in order to enjoy each other's company. |
[--- Table End ---]

explanations.27:
原因：“such as” 固定短语，表 “例如”。
词汇点：such as 列举例子，如 I like fruits such as apples and bananas.
explanations.28:
原因：“from...to...” 固定搭配，“从食物到文学”。
语法点：from A to B，如 from morning to night.
explanations.29:
原因：连接 4:30 和 6:00，表时间范围。
语法点：between...and...，如 between Monday and Friday.
explanations.30:
原因：“set up” 固定短语，“成立”。
词汇点：set up=establish，如 set up a company.
explanations.31:
原因：被动语态 “organised by volunteers”，“由志愿者组织”。
语法点：be done by sb.，如 The book is written by her.
explanations.32:
原因：现在完成时 “has grown”，“成员数量增长”。
语法点：the number of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语，如 The number of students has increased.
